task: Test and maintain a sump pump
steps: Unplug the pump and remove the pit lid.
Clean debris from the pit and check the intake screen.
Pour a bucket of water into the pit and confirm the float triggers the pump.
Verify the discharge line outside is clear and directs water away from the foundation.
Test a battery backup pump quarterly if you have one.
